function.name: check_calendar_availability
function.description: Checks the clinic's calendar for available appointment slots based on patient preferences.

date.description: The date to check in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, defaults to today.
date.title: Date

provider_id.description: The specific provider ID to check availability for. If not provided, checks any provider.
provider_id.title: Provider Id

service_type.description: The type of service requested, e.g. 'consult', 'cleaning', 'surgery'
service_type.title: Service Type
